summary: A toggle for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the switch and its accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from reaching the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when other visible text names the switch.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid.

value.note: Submitted with the form while checked.

checked.note: Current on/off state. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on to submit. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not submitted. Also true when a disabled fieldset contains the switch.

size.note: Track 32x20px (default) or 24x16px (sm). The label row keeps the hit area at least 24px high in both.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: switch in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Track wrapper; positions the thumb over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Decorative circle that slides to the end when on; aria-hidden, pointer-events none.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl).

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring in ring color outside the track (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track takes the primary fill and the thumb moves to the end; the position, not only the color, shows the state (WCAG 1.4.1). Direction follows :dir(rtl).

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled ancestor fieldset

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: ElementInternals: setFormValue(value) only while checked (nothing when off, like a checkbox), validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing), formResetCallback restores the default checked state from the checked attribute, formDisabledCallback follows a disabled fieldset and a disabled control is not submitted.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20px (default) or 24x16px (sm); the label next to it is part of the clickable row, so the target is at least 24px high and the 12px gap meets the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009). Enter does not toggle.

aria: role="switch" on the native input; aria-checked comes from its checked state
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
the thumb is aria-hidden; on/off is never conveyed by color alone
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)
a screen reader announces the state change (on/off) natively on toggle

useCases.when: A setting that is on or off and applies as soon as it is flipped
An on/off value submitted with a form
useCases.use: sb-switch with name; it submits value only while on

useCases.when: The setting needs its effect explained
Space is tight, as in a dense list or table row

antiPatterns.pattern: A yes/no choice recorded only on submit, such as accepting terms
antiPatterns.why: A switch reads as an immediate action; a recorded choice reads as a checkbox
A switch is a single on/off value

antiPatterns.pattern: A button-like toggle that stays pressed (bold, mute) in a toolbar
antiPatterns.why: Those are pressed states of an action, not settings

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that changes with the state (Enable / Disable)
antiPatterns.why: The state is already announced; a changing name confuses it
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label naming the setting

coverage: label is the name; label click toggles; role switch
Space toggles; Enter does not toggle but submits the form; keyboard focus ring
checked paints differently and the thumb moves (also in RTL)
description and error in the accessible description; aria-invalid
required: native required, aria-hidden asterisk, invalid after blur
input and change composed, once per toggle
form value only while on, custom value, reset to attribute default, validity, disabled fieldset, error customError, label for
default and sm sizes; target at least 24px high

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn default input track is neutral-200; changed for WCAG 1.4.11
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: the visual reference for look and API, the APG switch pattern for keyboard and ARIA, same architecture as Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Native input type=checkbox with role=switch, or a custom element with role=switch on a button?
openQuestions.answer: Native checkbox input with role=switch: free Space handling, validity, required and form value; consistent with Checkbox and SB-0007 (native elements first).

openQuestions.question: What is submitted when the switch is off?
openQuestions.answer: Nothing, exactly like a checkbox; value (default "on") is submitted only while on. A form that needs an explicit off adds its own hidden field.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No. The attribute is the default that form reset restores; same as Checkbox Q1.

openQuestions.question: Is label required?
openQuestions.answer: Yes, like Checkbox and Input; hide-label keeps it as the accessible name.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes?
openQuestions.answer: default (32x20 track) and sm (24x16), matching the visual reference and the existing size.switch tokens. No lg.

openQuestions.question: What does required mean for a switch?
openQuestions.answer: Native checkbox semantics: it must be on to submit (valueMissing when off). For consent-like gates; the label must say so.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch?
openQuestions.answer: No. Space toggles; Enter submits the form via requestSubmit (SB-0009), as for Checkbox.
